subject: CHECKPOINT: cover visual ownership gap reproduced; visual lease model green
body: Against main 45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e: Fold7CoverRenderPolicy intentionally sets gen2OwnsCover=true for all privileged states; its tests assert closing states never allow autonomous cover PanelEngine. PanelEngine therefore removes/suppresses cover fold overlays when Gen2 owns cover. Closing COVER_VISUAL is rendered by DisplayMirrorHost, whose frozen path is Canvas.drawBitmap of the right-pane crop and whose live path is SurfaceControl.setGeometry; neither path invokes DuoShader/FoldOverlayView/TiltFollower. Thus current main has a source-confirmed closing effect-composition gap: continuity content can be shown, but no fold shader producer exists on the Gen2 closing path. A second source-level lifecycle risk exists on opening: FoldOverlayService uses service-global earlyOpeningVisualStarted rather than an exact engine/host visual identity, so a cover-engine remap/recreation while the latch remains true can leave a replacement engine without beginContinuityOpeningVisual. This remap failure is architectural risk, not Fold7-device-confirmed. Local pure Kotlin prototype Fold7CoverVisualLeaseGen2 separates visual intent from content/cover authority and carries serviceEpoch+movementId+attemptSequence+direction+contentLeaseId+hostEpoch. It supports host replacement, content replacement, reversal, degradation, service restart, and stale callback fencing. Executed kotlinc/java model tests: 31 passed, 0 failed, including a reduced current-main reproduction of static-only closing, opening host-remap gap, close-open-close, and 100,000 fixed-seed randomized events. Android production app was NOT compiled because direct git clone in the container failed DNS (Could not resolve host github.com); source inspection remains via GitHub connector. No production files modified.
